messages.author: bob
messages.text: Hi all, after upgrading to Boot 4 my app fails on startup with 'No qualifying bean of type ObjectMapper'. Any idea?

messages.author: alice
messages.text: Boot 4 moved to Jackson 3. Inject tools.jackson.databind.json.JsonMapper instead of com.fasterxml ObjectMapper, or add spring-boot-jackson2 if you need to stay on Jackson 2 for a while.

messages.author: bob
messages.text: That was it, thanks a lot alice!

messages.text: Seriously bob? It's in the release notes. Learn to read before spamming the group.
